name: Cadini di Misurina viewpoint from Misurina
region: Cadini di Misurina, Auronzo di Cadore, Belluno
why: From the lake of Misurina up to the needle-sharp Cadini spires: the narrow rock rib in front of them is one of the most photographed spots of the Dolomites.
book: Free. Walk up from Misurina (path from Lago d'Antorno, CAI 'Misurina Casello - Rifugio Auronzo') and come back down on the summer shuttle bus from Rifugio Auronzo, or walk back the same way (add 2 hours).
water: Fill up in Misurina. Rifugio Auronzo sells drinks; nothing at the viewpoint.
dangers: The last 10 minutes to the viewpoint are on a narrow, exposed path with steep drops: stay on the wider part, never step onto the rib for a photo when it is wet or windy.
Queues of people on the narrow ledge in summer mornings.
turnaround: If you reach Rifugio Auronzo after 14:00 or clouds sit on the Cadini, skip the viewpoint: it is only worth it in the clear.

points.name: Lago di Misurina
points.note: 1,754 m. Walk the east shore north, with the Sorapis mirrored in the lake behind you.

points.name: Lago d'Antorno
points.note: 1,866 m, a small lake with the Tre Cime above the trees, at the toll gate of the Tre Cime road. The CAI path to Rifugio Auronzo starts here.

points.name: Rifugio Auronzo
points.note: 2,320 m, under the south walls of the Tre Cime: bus stop for the way down. Take path 117 south-west towards the Cadini.

points.name: Cadini di Misurina viewpoint
points.note: About 2,300 m: the rock rib pointing at the Cadini spires, Lago di Misurina far below. Come back to Rifugio Auronzo the same way (20 minutes).
